The rigorously derived graded interchange sign determines all other group traces. A separate enumeration of all 146689 augmented matching faces yields reduced Lefschetz totals (−1,−1,−1,−9), agreeing with all degreewise characters. value.rationale: The canonical commuting path reversals form a natural group action on the mixed-dimensional matching complex. Identifying exactly which of nine homology classes survive two independent reflections gives three top-degree quotient invariants not determined by nonequivariant sphere multiplicities. This is a complete and motivated symmetry classification for a natural representative within a published path-product family, rather than a routine recomputation of Betti ranks.
